reasons: CS2101 is placed in semester 6, the earliest possible, so it precedes CS4223 and satisfies the CP3880 communication prerequisite.
CS3210 is added in semester 6 because it is a required prerequisite for CS4223; CS4223 and CS3237 can only fit in semester 7 as Sem 1 courses.
CS2102 is in semester 6 because semester 7 is capped at 8 MC of non-ATAP courses and semester 8 must contain ES2660, which cannot be with CS2102.
